title: Keep PR-rule observation rechecks quiet
description: Pass a private operator-store copy in FARMSLOT_PR_RULES_PROOF_INPUT and a new evidence directory in FARMSLOT_PR_RULES_PROOF_OUTPUT. Uses isolated authenticated production RPC and a GitHub HTTP fixture. Never writes the operator store.

recheck.intent: Unchanged rechecks preserve disk bytes and RPC views without notifications; a new head persists and notifies a real client.
